content.value_statement: PowerPoint decks are hard because they combine analysis, narrative, layout, and accessibility requirements. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured workflow for planning, generating, and validating presentations.
actual_capabilities: Guides simple deck creation up to 15 slides with a single prompt template.
Defines a multi-chat architecture for complex decks of 30 or more slides.
Requires design plans with layout, color, typography, and emphasis rules.
Documents checks for contrast, font size, margins, overlap, and bullet count.
Provides brand integration guidance for colors, fonts, spacing, and visual rules.
Includes a GraphViz workflow diagram for simple and complex deck processes.
limitations: It provides workflow instructions and templates, not a standalone PowerPoint rendering engine.
It assumes an html2pptx workflow is available in the user environment.
It does not replace human review for data accuracy, messaging, or brand approval.
Large decks may still need section iteration and manual assembly checks.

use_cases.title: Executive Board Deck
use_cases.description: Create a polished presentation from financial data, memos, and key decisions.

use_cases.title: Branded Client Presentation
use_cases.description: Apply brand colors, typography, spacing, and accessibility rules to a client deck.

use_cases.title: Large Analysis Deck
use_cases.description: Split a long presentation into architect, generator, and assembly phases.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short presentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PowerPoint deck of up to 10 slides about [topic]. Use the simple workflow. Write a design plan first. Include accessibility checks.

prompt_templates.title: Turn Data Into Slides
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using source files or analysis notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these materials: [files or notes]. Build a presentation for [audience]. Include key insights, a clear story, and validation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Brand Guidelines
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for branded presentation output.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these brand guidelines: [brand details]. Extract colors, fonts, spacing, and constraints. Create a brand-adapted design plan and deck.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Complex Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a long executive presentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a [number]-slide executive deck using the complex architecture. Create the narrative, slide outline, generator instructions, and assembly checks.

output_examples.input: A team needs a 12-slide quarterly business review from finance notes and customer metrics.
output_examples.output: A planned deck with an executive summary, metric slides, risk analysis, recommendations, and validation notes.

output_examples.input: A consultant needs a branded strategy presentation using client colors and typography.
output_examples.output: A brand-adapted deck plan with accessible layouts, color usage, typography hierarchy, and slide requirements.

output_examples.input: An analyst needs a 35-slide market analysis presentation from several source documents.
output_examples.output: A multi-phase plan with architect outputs, section instructions, assembly checks, and consistency validation.

best_practices: Start with the design plan before generating slide content.
Use the simple workflow for short decks and complex architecture for long decks.
Run the validation checklist before considering the presentation complete.
anti_patterns: Do not generate a complex deck in one pass without a master design plan.
Do not use bordered text boxes, outline shapes, or rounded rectangles with text.
Do not skip contrast, font size, margin, and overlap checks.

faq.question: Does this skill generate PowerPoint files directly?
faq.answer: It provides workflows, prompts, and validation steps. It expects a compatible html2pptx workflow.

faq.question: When should I use the complex deck architecture?
faq.answer: Use it for decks with 30 or more slides, or when many visual elements exceed one context window.

faq.question: Can it follow brand guidelines?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes steps for extracting brand colors, typography, spacing, and constraints.

faq.question: How does it improve slide quality?
faq.answer: It requires planning, layout constraints, accessibility checks, and validation gates before final delivery.

faq.question: Is it suitable for executive presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. The templates support board decks, reports, strategy analysis, and stakeholder presentations.

faq.question: What are the main accessibility checks?
faq.answer: The checklist covers contrast, font sizes, margins, overlapping elements, bullet count, and thumbnail readability.
